payload.title: Add GA4 with Consent Mode v2, consent banner, CTA events and contact CTAs
payload.description:
As a site owner, I want GA4 (G-31SC26SDGX) with Consent Mode v2 region defaults, a first-party consent banner with a Cookie settings reopen link, cta_click and sign_up events without personal data, and contact CTAs to anth.us/engage, so that Babulus measures conversions the same way as anth.us (approved by Ryan for all Anthus sites).

Copy the anth.us implementation (Papyrus consent.py + Anth.us-web conversion-events.js and availability labels). /privacy gets an analytics section. Home-page feature status labels driven by one config value per feature. Closes after Ryan approves the PR and it deploys.
